listing.description_html:
A real month-by-month payoff schedule for up to six debts: your debt-free month, total interest, and how much you save against paying minimums only.

This planner calculates that plan month by month for up to six debts, for up to ten years: the balance of every debt every month, the month each one is paid off, the month you are debt-free, and the total interest. It also estimates what the same debts would cost if you paid minimums only, so you can see the interest you save.

What's included

  • True month-by-month schedule for up to six debts and 120 months, with automatic rollover of freed-up payments
  • Your debt-free month and the payoff month of every single debt
  • Total interest with your plan versus an estimate for minimum payments only, and the interest saved
  • Works for avalanche (highest rate first) or snowball (smallest balance first): just order the rows
  • Warning when a minimum payment does not cover the monthly interest
  • PDF guide with a worked four-debt example

Who it's for

  • Anyone paying down credit cards, store cards, personal loans or car loans
  • Couples agreeing a shared payoff plan and budget
  • Readers of debt-free books who want the numbers for their own debts
  • Coaches and counsellors preparing a plan with a client

You get: debt_payoff_planner.xlsx (Plan, Debts, Schedule) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a budgeting aid, not financial, credit or legal advice. It assumes fixed interest rates and that you make every payment on time; lenders' real statements may differ slightly because of daily interest and fees.
